name: SJV Awards Program
summary: Competitive awards for short-term bird and habitat conservation projects in the Sonoran Joint Venture region. The 2026 priorities include habitat restoration, Indigenous stewardship, monitoring and partnership capacity.

geography.label: southwestern United States and northwestern Mexico

steps: Staff and review subcommittee review and ranking

eligibility.rule: Work is in or directly affects SJV-region birds and habitats, in one of six focal ecosystems
Project contributes to a Conservation Implementation Plan goal or objective
Project does not support lobbying activities
U.S.: 501(c)(3) nonprofit; Mexico: A.C. with donataria autorizada status and a bank account in its name
If previously funded, current grant is in good standing or all prior reports were submitted

status.quote: September 24 - Proposals must be received by the Sonoran Joint Venture no later than midnight, Pacific Daylight time.

geography.quote: The Sonoran Joint Venture is a regional partnership working to conserve the unique birds and habitats of the southwestern United States and northwestern Mexico.

access.quote: Put all proposal components into a single Word document or PDF (cover sheet, project narrative, budget, and, if relevant, letters of support). Email the document to the Sonoran Joint Venture.

window.quote: September 10 - Request for Proposals made available. September 24 - Proposals must be received by the Sonoran Joint Venture no later than midnight, Pacific Daylight time.

amount.quote: Individual SJV Awards Program grants range from $5,000-$10,000, and we anticipate funding four to six awards in 2026.

effort.quote: September 24 - Proposals must be received by the Sonoran Joint Venture no later than midnight, Arizona/Pacific Daylight time.
SJV Staff and Awards Review Subcommittee complete review and ranking process and provide recommendations to SJV Management Board.

eligibility.quote: Focus on work conducted in or having a direct impact on birds and habitats of the SJV region, in one of the six focal ecosystems in the SJV Conservation Implementation Plan (see below)
Contribute to one or more of the goals and objectives of the SJV Conservation Implementation Plan (see below).
Come from an applicant in good standing.

For U.S. applicants: Be a nonprofit with 501(c)3 status. For Mexican applicants: Be legally incorporated as an Asociación Civil (A.C.), have current donataria autorizada status, and maintain a bank account in the legal name of the organizations. All three requirements must be met to be eligible to receive funding.

Applicants who received prior Awards for a project may apply for additional funding under a new application if their current grant is in good standing and/or they have submitted all appropriate reports for prior grants.

documents.quote: Map of Project Area: Include a map that clearly delineates the project area and is large enough to be legible. Label any sites referenced in the project narrative. Budget Include a budget table that demonstrates how the requested funds will be spent.
